title: The duplicate-name check in `Records::map` takes 2.2 s on 2.4M targets
body:
`Records::map` in `nail/src/io/records.rs` maps an input with libsail's `Framed::map`, then builds the name index with `framed.name_index()`. It then refuses a file that repeats a record name. For each record `n` it allocates the name as a `String`, looks the name up with `position`, and bails if the first match is not `n`. The check exists because the index libsail replaced refused repeated names, and a lookup by name returns only the first record. The loop runs on one thread.

On the 2,455,940-record mgy target fasta, with a warm page cache on the 16-core box:

| step | seconds |
|---|---|
| `Framed::map` | 0.07 |
| `Framed::map` and `name_index` | 0.87 |
| `Fasta::from_path`, which adds the duplicate check | 3.04 to 3.08 |

The duplicate check costs about 2.2 s, and it is the largest part of the 3.36 s target index in the 8-thread run on the parent issue. The timer is the scratch crate in `tmp-claude/2026-10-14-serial-overhead/index-split`.

## Open

- Whether libsail's name index can report a repeated name while it builds, which would make the loop unnecessary.
- If not, whether the loop can skip the `String` allocation and run over rayon.
close_reason: Commit `a8a28e5` on `dev` replaced the binary search with `refuse_repeated_names`, one `HashSet` per rayon thread sharded by name hash. The target index on 2,455,940 targets at `-t 8` went from 3.3 s to 1.0 s. A neighbour pass in libsail would remove the check entirely and is not filed yet. nail-fe0f9e tests the scaling claim on a larger box.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/95b307ba
notes.text: Dropping the check is rejected, by Jack. nail tells records apart by position, so a repeated name would run without error. A reader of the tabular output could not tell two such records apart, and nothing in the output would show the problem. The comment on the loop in `Records::map` now says this. A fix makes the check cheaper and keeps it.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/95b307ba
notes.text: The check is now `refuse_repeated_names` in `records.rs`, uncommitted. It hashes names in parallel and checks one `HashSet` per rayon thread, sharded by name hash. Removing the `String` alone changed nothing, 3.30 s against 3.04 s before, because the cost was the binary search in `position`. The variant timings are in nail-fe0f9e. In nail, the target index on 2,455,940 targets at `-t 8` went from 3.24 to 3.35 s down to 0.94 to 1.01 s, and the rest is `Framed::map` and `name_index`. A new test, `a_repeated_name_is_refused`, with fixture `fixtures/repeated-name.fa`, fails when the call to the check is removed.
